name: the twin's ocean and atmosphere layer
plain: The CEWP twin's globe layer for the ocean's colour, the sun's glint and the atmosphere's limb: one shader, with colours and glint chosen for looks. The twin's own claims ledger records it as claim layer-illustration, class MODEL, 'labelled decoration'.

carrier.state: a shell drawn at 1.032 Earth radii (about twice the real 100 km), Rayleigh weights 1/λ⁴ at 680/550/440 nm, Mie g = 0.76, lit from the twin's simulated sun

source.external: CIRISAI/CEWP docs/gfx.js, gfxOcean and the shaders OV/OF

views.reads: colour drawn over and around the globe

not_claimed: Nothing checks this shader against an atmosphere or an ocean. No holon-draw mark draws it: it is the twin's own program.
